en.headline: sogeisetsu: 7 commits in sopen-translate, 0.2.0 bump and 797-entry glossary
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 `sogeisetsu` made **7 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`. Page-translation performance work led the day: batches are now sized by provider policy with bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting, and the batch budget was raised to 8k/400 with 8 lanes plus retries for failed batches. That was followed by a fix in `options`/`popup` keeping the model cache TTL honest and guarding the restore status fetch, and a release bump to `0.2.0` with docs synced to the bilingual and glossary work. A feature commit shipped an offline-built builtin glossary term list with 797 entries, and the planning docs recorded real-device acceptance results for C6. Housekeeping included ignoring locally installed agent skills. Separately, **16 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`; no PRs, issues, reviews, releases, discussions or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：sopen-translate 提交 7 次，版本升至 0.2.0 并内置 797 条术语
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，`sogeisetsu` 共完成 **7 次本人提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`。当天以页面翻译性能优化为主：按服务商策略划分批次，加入有界并发与自适应拆分，并把批次预算提升到 8k/400、8 条通道，同时为失败批次增加重试。随后在 `options`/`popup` 中修正模型缓存 TTL 的准确性，并为恢复状态请求增加防护；版本号升至 `0.2.0`，文档与双语及术语表相关改动同步更新。一项功能提交上线了离线构建的内置术语表，共 797 条，规划文档中则记录了 C6 真机验收结果。杂项方面忽略了本地安装的 agent skills。此外，`github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中产生了 **16 次自动提交**；当天没有 PR、issue、评审、发布、讨论或状态变更记录。
